title: 49ers inactive list: The top 4 WRs from Week 1 won’t play

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 49ers inactive list: The top 4 WRs from Week 1 won’t play
sources.description: The 49ers took the field in Australia with Mike Evans, De’Zhaun Stribling, Demarcus Robinson, and Deebo Samuel against the Rams. Neither of those players will be in uniform in Atlanta.
